current_metrics.methodology_label:
Generic bond-implied breakeven inflation / inflation compensation.
Computed as nominal_yield_pct - real_yield_pct at the same tenor.
Same-country construction only: the nominal sovereign and linker
legs must share country and currency (e.g. UST + USD_TIPS,
UK_GILT + GBP_LINKER, FR_OAT + EUR_FR_LINKER, CANADA_GOVT +
CAD_RRB).  Cross-country pairs (e.g. DE_BUND vs EUR_FR_LINKER, or
UK_GILT vs USD_TIPS) are refused at compute time with a controlled
error envelope; this invariant is enforced in code (not via a YAML
allow-list) per DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md §5.  The output is
INFLATION COMPENSATION, NOT a clean expected-inflation read,
because the differential carries an inflation risk premium and a
relative liquidity premium between the nominal sovereign and the
linker.  Use as a proxy for inflation expectations only with that
caveat in mind.

time_series_breakeven.description: Generic bond-implied breakeven inflation (UST − USD_TIPS) at 10Y over the displayed window.  Inflation compensation; not a clean expected-inflation read (carries inflation risk premium and liquidity premium).

time_series_zscore.description: Rolling z-score of the UST−USD_TIPS bond-implied breakeven (in bps) at 10Y vs its own trailing window.
